scope: Initial security-sensitive static trace of authentication/session, OIDC/OAuth, outbound host validation, remote fetch, image proxy and email HTML sanitization. No tests were executed against the snapshot during this static trace.

source_files.observed: Express auth routes; bcrypt, crypto, TOTP/QRCode, DB transactions, encrypted credentials, host validation, SMTP, rate limiter, auth events, Redis sessions, session destruction and preference sanitizers.
requireAuth and requireAdmin; admin status is read from PostgreSQL at request time.
DB-backed auth limiter configuration with default 10 requests per 15-minute window.
7-day session idle window; HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax and secure-auto cookie configuration.

openQuestions: Trace all auth endpoints and transitions, reset-token schema/consumption, MFA enrollment/recovery, session rotation and logout across WebSocket/Redis.
Map every environment/config dependency and negative test; static inspection is not a test pass.

source_files.observed: Microsoft and Google OAuth/device flow, state nonce, token exchange/refresh and encrypted token persistence.
OIDC discovery/JWKS/token validation, provider state/nonce/PKCE, private-issuer policy checks, bounded HTTP(S) calls and session regeneration.

openQuestions: Trace all OIDC metadata and JWKS fetch call sites, issuer/audience/nonce/PKCE enforcement and provider configuration persistence.
Confirm private-host opt-in behavior and execution-time policy rechecks across all discovery/token/end-session requests.

source_files.observed: IPv4/IPv6 private/reserved range checks, IDNA ASCII normalization, DNS A/AAAA/system resolver checks and pinned lookup for connection targets.
Undici connector validates literal IPs and all resolved addresses, blocks private/reserved destinations by default and requires HTTPS unless explicitly configured otherwise.

openQuestions: Trace redirect behavior and confirm the connector is re-applied on every redirect hop for all safeFetch callers.
Map the policy that allows private hosts and prove it is rechecked at use time; review DNS rebinding/time-of-check behavior for every IMAP/SMTP/OIDC path.

source_files.observed: Uses safeFetch; 10 MiB max response, 15 s overall timeout, 8 s header timeout, per-user concurrency limit 6, image signature sniffing and private response caching.
Message/body/image/attachment routes call image proxy, safe fetch, cache, shrink/inline image helpers and sanitizer.
Frontend URL rewrite and proxy routing helper.

openQuestions: Trace all callers and per-user cache key/isolation; confirm all redirects re-enter safeFetch guards.
Inspect body limiter implementation and content-type/disposition headers; verify user-facing error and cache behavior.

source_files.observed: sanitize-html plus parse5; strips email head, sanitizes email/compose/signature HTML, rewrites anchors, blocks/proxies remote images and transforms CSS/style content.
Applies sanitization to mail body and integrates image proxy and CID handling.

openQuestions: Trace rendering sink and every email/compose/signature sanitizer caller; confirm no alternate unsafe HTML path.
Map all sanitization transforms to browser-visible behavior and negative tests.
